title: pp.shepphaser~
description: `pp.shepphaser~` produces a Shepard tone-like phaser effect using an audio-rate phase shift, resonance, and a selectable number of active allpass-filter stages. Its phase-shift input spans 0–1 for one cycle, and the maximum number of stages is set by the first creation argument (default 4), as in `pp.shepphaser~ 8`.
